# breakout_terminal fixtures — SYNTHETIC

Every file here is **invented** (lane PROP-TERM, 2026-09-28) to the generic
vocabulary in `src/prop/platform/breakout_terminal.py`. None was captured from
Breakout's proprietary terminal: no account exists on it, and the dashboard's
login page has not yet been recorded (`breakout-terminal-probe` does that).
They prove the parsers and the in-page JS, not the real layout. Replace each
with a captured, REDACTED copy (no credentials, account numbers or
screenshots) once the probe has run.

`positions_table.html.txt` (added 2026-09-29) models a positions TABLE whose
row carries a text-less reverse / edit / close icon trio. That is dxtrade's
MEASURED row shape (live test #14191), used here only to exercise the
hardened close-control selection the adapter shares with dxtrade.
